learning_outcomes.text: Explain what a web server does and how Nginx handles requests
Describe Nginx configuration structure and serving static content
Explain using Nginx as a reverse proxy and load balancer
Describe enabling TLS, caching and performance features
Explain operating, logging and hardening an Nginx server

integrative_case: A team must put a web application behind Nginx. Serve the static assets, reverse-proxy the app and load-balance across several instances, terminate TLS, add caching and compression, then set up logging, rate limiting and security headers. Diagnose a 502 from the logs and defend the configuration at an ops review.
